svg.title: What people see in Slack (simulated view)
svg.desc: The messages the workflow posts for made-up leads in the replay of the tested code: direct messages to the new owner, routing alerts, the watchdog and the weekly numbers. Not a screenshot of a live Slack workspace.

g.text: LR

svg.text: Simulated view of the messages the workflow posts, from the same replay. Not a screenshot of a live Slack workspace.
Direct messages to the new owner

g.text: New tier A lead for you: Kari Heikkinen, CTO at Valoverkko Oy (FI).
Why you: Next rep in the NORDICS round robin (tier A: senior
reps first). Summary: Regional fiber operator wants a demo of
multi-vendor monitoring. Open in HubSpot
New tier A lead for you: Erik Lund, CTO at Harbor Fiber (SE).
Why you: The company's owner has left: routed to the regional
team lead, with a task to reassign the company. Summary: Needs a
demo of fiber network monitoring before a January tender.

svg.text: Also created in HubSpot for Ville: the task "Reassign Harbor Fiber AB: its owner has left",
due the next day, high priority, linked to the company.

g.text: Routing alert: The company's owner has left: routed to the
regional team lead, with a task to reassign the company.
Lead: Erik Lund, CTO at Harbor Fiber (SE).
Routing alert: Country unknown or outside the four regions:
sent to the routing queue. Lead: Dana Brooks, VP Network
Engineering at Prairie Wireless (US).

svg.text: 09:10 watchdog, test case: a run that failed half-way

g.text: 1 lead not routed and without an owner after 5 minutes:
- Stuck Lead: waiting 11 min open
